Subject: Upgrade pipeline scrub + CS alignment

Team + Bethany —

Quick scrub ahead of the week: finance is doing a targeted commit refresh for upgrade/expansion opportunities that are currently inside Q2 coverage. I pulled the sheet attached (Q2_upsell_sheet.xlsx) and flagged 6 accounts we think should be in the commit cadence. Ask: can CS owners update stage, latest customer signal, and your confidence score (0–100) in the Google sheet by EOD Wednesday?

Specifically, please call out:
- New expected close date if it moved (we need accurate month/quarter for revenue planning)
- Any procurement/legal blockers (Bethany, I copied procurement)
- Which feature gates are required for the upsell (quant/infra/enterprise features)

Bethany — quick note for Acme (one of the flagged accounts): do you still anticipate Q2 close for the +25 GPU pool upgrade? If not, let us know the blocker and timing.

I attached the current price proposal (redwood-price-proposal-v2.pdf) for reference. I’ll compile updates and run a short commit readout on Thursday 10am PT — invite to follow.

Thanks,
Karthik
SVP, Growth @ Redwood Inference

Attachments: Q2_upsell_sheet.xlsx, redwood-price-proposal-v2.pdf

Karthik —

Thanks for the note. I pulled the sheet and made preliminary updates for the Acme row and three other accounts. Summary:
- Acme Financials: moved expected close from 2026-03-31 to 2026-04-15, confidence -> 60% (legal review started).
- NovaPulse: no change, confidence -> 85% (PO received, finance sign-off pending).
- Horizon Health: reduced ARR uplift to $18k/mo (previously $24k) given scope change, confidence -> 50%.

I left inline comments on the sheet where I had questions for the AMs.

On Acme: Bethany, we noted a legal clause request around data retention. Can you confirm if your legal team requires an on-prem addendum or if the KMS options in our proposal suffice? If it’s an addendum, that will push the timeline.

-Monica

Thanks for the heads-up. Short update from Acme: legal reviewed the proposal and asked for two small changes to the data retention section and an explicit cross-border data transfer clause. Our procurement team is ok on price but needs those redlines before legal signs off. I’ve looped procurement@acme.com.

If Redwood can accept the two retention edits (both are limited in scope), we can likely close mid-April (around 2026-04-15). If the changes require an on-prem addendum, that will push to late Q2.

Also, quick question on invoicing cadence: can Redwood do NET 30 with a purchase order? Procurement, can you confirm required billing terms?

Best,
